temple-gopuram.name: Temple Gopuram
temple-gopuram.description: A South Indian temple wedding — a carved gopuram crowns your names, brass kuthuvilakku lamps glow below, and maroon and temple gold carry through every section.

mandap-marigold.name: Marigold Mandap
mandap-marigold.description: A North Indian shaadi under a marigold-draped mandap — rani pink, saffron and gold, with a kalash and a Ganesh invocation.

rajwada-palace.name: Rajwada Palace
rajwada-palace.description: A Rajasthani palace wedding in miniature-painting style — carved jharokha arches, dancing peacocks, indigo and gold leaf.

lotus-peacock.name: Lotus & Peacock
lotus-peacock.description: A soft, devotional look inspired by Radha Krishna — lotus pond, a peacock feather and flute, in sage, blush and peacock teal.

nikah-emerald.name: Emerald Nikah
nikah-emerald.description: An elegant Nikah invitation — pointed Mughal arches, eight-point star lattice and a Bismillah in Arabic calligraphy, in emerald and antique gold.

walima-moonlit.name: Moonlit Walima
walima-moonlit.description: A night of blessings — a crescent moon, hanging brass lanterns and a domed skyline in midnight navy and gold, for the Nikah and Walima.

church-stained-glass.name: Stained Glass
church-stained-glass.description: A church wedding in ivory and gold — a stained-glass rose window, white lilies and a verse from Corinthians for your Holy Matrimony.

christian-garden.name: Garden Blessing
christian-garden.description: A fresh garden wedding — a dove with an olive branch, white roses and sage greenery, airy and full of grace.

luxe-editorial.name: Luxe Editorial
luxe-editorial.description: High-fashion minimalism — oversized Didone type, ivory paper, black ink and a single line of gold foil, like the cover of a wedding issue.

watercolor-botanical.name: Watercolour Botanical
watercolor-botanical.description: Loose, hand-painted watercolour florals in peach, blush and sage on warm paper — the world's favourite invitation style.

boho-arch.name: Boho Sun Arch
boho-arch.description: A modern boho look — your names inside a tall terracotta arch with a rising sun and dried pampas grass.

velvet-gold.name: Velvet & Gold
velvet-gold.description: An evening of old-world glamour — wine-red velvet damask, gold filigree and candlelight for a grand reception.

traditional-gold.name: Traditional Gold
traditional-gold.description: A kolam draws itself on granite and the temple bell rings open your invitation — temple gold, jasmine and lamp light throughout.

minimal-modern.name: Minimal Modern
minimal-modern.description: A single hairline splits the page to reveal your names — generous whitespace, big confident type, and nothing more.

floral-pastel.name: Floral Pastel
floral-pastel.description: A peony bud blooms open and butterflies fly out — soft blush and sage, with a vine that grows as guests scroll.

elegant-bw.name: Elegant Black & White
elegant-bw.description: Guests pull a satin ribbon to open a black gift box and lift out a silver card — monochrome, theatrical, timeless.

beach-boho.name: Beach Boho
beach-boho.description: A message in a bottle washes ashore and a wave reveals your invitation — the sky turns from noon to sunset as guests scroll.

anniversary-emerald.name: Emerald Anniversary
anniversary-emerald.description: Rich emerald and gold for celebrating another year of a lasting love.

valentine-blush.name: Blush Valentine
valentine-blush.description: Warm reds and soft blush for a sweet, romantic Valentine's Day note.

proposal-starlit.name: Starlit Proposal
proposal-starlit.description: A midnight-blue, starlit scene for announcing the moment someone said yes.

birthday-confetti.name: Confetti Birthday
birthday-confetti.description: Bold color and confetti for a birthday party invite that isn't shy about it.

housewarming-terracotta.name: Terracotta House Warming
housewarming-terracotta.description: Earthy terracotta and greenery for welcoming friends to your new home.

silk-curtain.name: Silk Curtain
silk-curtain.description: Guests pull a gold tassel and silk stage curtains sweep open on your names, with gold dust in the footlights.

scratch-reveal.name: Scratch & Reveal
scratch-reveal.description: Guests scratch a rose-gold foil card to uncover your date — confetti bursts the moment it's revealed.

lantern-night.name: Lantern Night
lantern-night.description: Guests light a clay lamp and a wave of glowing lanterns rises into the night sky — a Karthigai Deepam feel.

thoranam-jasmine.name: Thoranam & Jasmine
thoranam-jasmine.description: A Tamil wedding doorway: a mango-leaf thoranam swings in and strings of jasmine part as kolam dots bloom.

kerala-kasavu.name: Kasavu & Nilavilakku
kerala-kasavu.description: A kasavu cloth unrolls and the brass nilavilakku lights wick by wick — a Kerala temple wedding.

pookalam.name: Pookalam
pookalam.description: An Onam pookalam is laid ring by ring — marigold, chethi, thumba — then opens onto your invitation.

grand-reception.name: Grand Reception
grand-reception.description: A cinematic reception opening: spotlights sweep the stage and a marquee of bulbs lights up your names with gold confetti.

engagement-ring.name: Ring Box
engagement-ring.description: A velvet ring box on blush satin — one tap opens the lid, the ring rises in a sparkle and your names appear.

baby-moon.name: Moon Cradle
baby-moon.description: A crescent-moon cradle and a mobile of stars on a pastel dusk — tap the moon to rock it and send bubbles floating up.

corporate-ticket.name: Event Pass
corporate-ticket.description: A clean event pass on a midnight grid — guests tear off the "Admit one" stub to open your invitation, with RSVP built in.

engagement-sparkle.name: Diamond Sparkle
engagement-sparkle.tagline: A ring box, diamonds & champagne gold
engagement-sparkle.description: A ring box opens to your names, diamond sparkles drift across a champagne-gold page — made for the moment you said yes.

engagement-thamboolam.name: Nichayathartham
engagement-thamboolam.description: A Tamil nichayathartham — a mango-leaf thoranam, a thamboolam plate of betel, bananas and turmeric, and banana-leaf green with marigold gold.

engagement-rose-garden.name: Rose Garden
engagement-rose-garden.description: Hand-painted watercolour roses bloom around your names, with blush and sage washes through every section.

engagement-save-the-date.name: Save the Date
engagement-save-the-date.description: A magazine-style save-the-date: a black cover with your gold-foil monogram lifts away to crisp editorial type.

engagement-mangni.name: Royal Mangni
engagement-mangni.description: A Rajasthani ring ceremony — carved jharokha shutters open onto rani pink, peacock teal and gold.

anniversary-golden-jubilee.name: Golden Jubilee
anniversary-golden-jubilee.description: Velvet curtains part in candlelight for fifty golden years — deep gold and warm light for a grand anniversary.

anniversary-vintage-reel.name: Vintage Reel
anniversary-vintage-reel.tagline: Sepia, film frames & old love letters
anniversary-vintage-reel.description: A vintage keepsake — sepia tones, film-strip frames and a sealed letter for a love that has only grown.

anniversary-wine-roses.name: Wine & Roses
anniversary-wine-roses.tagline: Deep red roses & a velvet curtain
anniversary-wine-roses.description: A romantic evening in wine red — velvet curtains, deep roses and soft gold for an anniversary dinner.

anniversary-silver-jubilee.name: Silver Jubilee
anniversary-silver-jubilee.description: Twenty-five years in silver — a foil card lifts to reveal starlight sparkles on cool silver and white.

anniversary-shashtiabdapoorthi.name: Shashtiabdapoorthi
anniversary-shashtiabdapoorthi.description: The sacred 60th — a temple gopuram, brass lamps and kolam for Shashtiabdapoorthi, with the family's blessings.

collegeSweethearts.title: College sweethearts
collegeSweethearts.text: {a} and {b} first met in a crowded college canteen, arguing over the last samosa. Years later, they are ready to turn that campus love story into a lifetime together — and they would love for you to be there as it begins.

childhoodFriends.title: Childhood friends
childhoodFriends.text: {a} and {b} grew up on the same street, sharing lunch boxes, bicycle rides and every festival in between. Their families always joked that the two were inseparable — no one imagined how right they were. After a lifetime of friendship, they are finally making it official, and they want the people who watched them grow up to be right there with them.

loveArranged.title: Love-cum-arranged
loveArranged.text: When their families first arranged for {a} and {b} to meet, both of them expected a polite cup of coffee and nothing more. Instead, one conversation stretched into hours, and a few meetings became a friendship that felt like it had always been there. With the blessings of both families and two hearts that chose each other, they now begin their journey together.

matrimony.title: Matched online
matrimony.text: It started with a profile, a hesitant first message and a phone call that lasted far longer than planned. {a} and {b} discovered they laughed at the same jokes, dreamed of the same places and valued the same things. What began on a screen grew into something wonderfully real, and now they are ready to say yes to forever.

colleagues.title: Met at work
colleagues.text: {a} and {b} met on their first day at the same office, both lost and looking for the right meeting room. Shared deadlines became shared lunches, and shared lunches became the best part of every day. Somewhere between the coffee breaks and the long projects, they found the partner they had been looking for.

longDistance.title: Long distance
longDistance.text: For years, {a} and {b} loved each other across cities, time zones and countless video calls. They counted down the days between visits and learned that distance only made their bond stronger. Now the waiting is finally over — they are closing the miles for good and would love to celebrate with you.

friendsWedding.title: Met at a wedding
friendsWedding.text: {a} and {b} met at a friend’s wedding, seated at the same table and laughing through every speech. They spent the evening talking instead of dancing and left with each other’s numbers and a feeling they could not shake. Today the guests have become the couple, and it is their turn to invite you to celebrate.

traditionalBlessing.title: Traditional blessing
traditionalBlessing.text: With the blessings of the Almighty and the grace of our elders, we joyfully announce the wedding of {a} and {b}. Two families come together in love and respect, bound by tradition and the hope of a bright future. Your presence and blessings on this auspicious day will make our celebration complete.

firstYear.title: First anniversary
firstYear.text: One year ago, {a} and {b} said yes to a lifetime together. It has been a year of new beginnings, small adventures, burnt dinners and endless laughter. Join us as we raise a toast to the first of many years to come.

silverJubilee.title: 25 years together
silverJubilee.text: Twenty-five years ago, {a} and {b} began a journey filled with love, patience and countless shared moments. Through a growing family, new homes and every season of life, they have stood by each other. Come celebrate their silver jubilee with the people who have been part of their story.

goldenJubilee.title: 50 golden years
goldenJubilee.text: Fifty years of love, faith and togetherness — {a} and {b} have built a family and a legacy that inspires everyone around them. Their children and grandchildren invite you to join in honouring this golden milestone. Your presence would mean the world to them.

renewal.title: Renewing our vows
renewal.text: All these years later, {a} and {b} would still choose each other every single time. So they are saying their vows once more, surrounded by the people who have cheered them on along the way. Come witness a promise that has only grown stronger with time.

simpleNote.title: A simple note
simpleNote.text: {b}, every day with you feels like a gift I never expected to receive. This Valentine’s Day, I just want a quiet evening with the person who makes my world brighter. Save the date — it’s a plan for two. — {a}

everyday.title: Everyday love
everyday.text: It’s not the grand gestures, {b} — it’s the morning chai, the silly texts and the way you always save me the last bite. Thank you for turning ordinary days into my favourite memories. Let’s celebrate us. With love, {a}

adventure.title: Our next adventure
adventure.text: {b}, you’re my favourite travel partner, my best listener and my partner in every crazy plan. This Valentine’s Day, I’ve planned a little surprise just for you. Bring your smile and meet me there. — {a}

sunset.title: At sunset
sunset.text: {b}, from the day we met, every sunset has looked more beautiful with you beside me. I have a special evening planned and one very important question to ask. Please meet me there — I can’t wait. — {a}

sinceDayOne.title: Since day one
sinceDayOne.text: {b}, I think I knew from our very first conversation. You make me laugh, you make me braver and you make every day feel like home. I’d love to spend the rest of my life proving that to you. Will you meet me for a moment we’ll remember forever? — {a}

withFamily.title: With our families
withFamily.text: With love and the blessings of both families, {a} has a special question for {b}. Join us for a joyful evening as two hearts take their first step towards a lifetime together.

bestFriend.title: For a best friend
bestFriend.text: Happy birthday, {a}! You bring the fun, the laughter and the best stories to every gathering. Join us to celebrate the most wonderful person we know with cake, music and a whole lot of love.

firstBirthday.title: First birthday
firstBirthday.text: Our little star {a} is turning one! A year of tiny giggles, first steps and endless joy has flown by. Come celebrate this very special day with us and shower our little one with your blessings.

manivizha.title: 60th birthday (Manivizha)
manivizha.text: With great joy, we celebrate the 60th birthday of {a} — a lifetime of love, wisdom and kindness. Family and friends are warmly invited to the Manivizha celebration to offer their blessings for many more healthy, happy years.

milestone.title: Milestone birthday
milestone.text: {a} is stepping into a brand new chapter, and there’s no better reason to celebrate! Come join us for an evening of good food, great company and memories in the making.

grihaPravesam.title: Griha Pravesam
grihaPravesam.text: With the blessings of the Almighty, we warmly invite you to the Griha Pravesam of our new home. Please join us for the pooja and share in our joy as we begin this new chapter with your blessings. — {a}

casualParty.title: Housewarming party
casualParty.text: We’ve unpacked (mostly) and we’re ready to celebrate! We would love for you to come and see the new place — good food, good company and a proper house tour included. — {a}

firstHome.title: Our first home
firstHome.text: After years of dreaming and planning, we have finally found a place to call home. A home is only complete with the people who fill it with love, so please come and celebrate with us. — {a}

familiesMeet.title: When our families met
familiesMeet.text: Our families met over filter coffee and a long list of questions — and by the end of the evening, {a} and {b} were the ones who couldn't stop talking. With the blessings of our elders, we exchange rings and begin the journey to our wedding. Please join us.

loveStory.title: Our love story
loveStory.text: What began as a friendship between {a} and {b} slowly became the most important part of our lives. Now, with both our families beside us, we are making it official. Come and celebrate our engagement with us.

traditional.title: Traditional blessing
traditional.text: With the grace of the Almighty and the blessings of our families, the engagement of {a} and {b} will be celebrated with the customary rituals. We request your presence and blessings on this auspicious day.

valaikaappu.title: Valaikaappu
valaikaappu.text: With joy in our hearts, we celebrate the Valaikaappu of {a}. Bangles, blessings and good food await — please come and shower your love on the mother-to-be and the little one on the way.

babyShower.title: Baby shower
babyShower.text: A little one is on the way! Join us for an afternoon of games, cake and happy tears as we celebrate {a} before the newest member of our family arrives.

namingCeremony.title: Naming ceremony
namingCeremony.text: Our little star has arrived, and it is time to give our baby a name. Please join us for the naming ceremony of {a} and bless our child with your love.

productLaunch.title: Product launch
productLaunch.text: {a} invites you to the launch of our newest product — an evening of first looks, live demos and conversations with the team that built it. We would love to have you there.

annualDay.title: Annual day
annualDay.text: Another year of hard work, big wins and great people. {a} invites you to our Annual Day — awards, performances and dinner together as we celebrate the year gone by.

conference.title: Conference
conference.text: {a} welcomes you to a day of talks, workshops and networking with leaders across the industry. Reserve your seat and RSVP below.

topics.editingBody: Use the private edit link from your publish confirmation. Keep it safe — it is the key to your invitation.

faq.editLinkQ: How do I make changes after publishing?
faq.editLinkA: Right after payment we show your private edit link. Open it any time to change text, photos or the design, then press Save changes — the live invitation updates immediately.
faq.lostLinkQ: I lost my edit link. What now?
faq.lostLinkA: Contact us with your invitation link and your Razorpay payment ID. Once we confirm it is yours, we will send the edit link again.
faq.changeDesignQ: Can I switch to a different design later?
faq.changeDesignA: Yes. Use Switch design in the editor — your names, dates, story, family and photos stay; only the look changes.
faq.rsvpQ: Where do I see who is coming?
faq.rsvpA: Open your guest list (View RSVPs) from the editor or your edit link. It shows every response, guest counts and messages, and lets you send reminders.
faq.whatsappQ: How do I send the invitation on WhatsApp?
faq.whatsappA: Use Share on WhatsApp on the invitation or in your guest list. You can also create personal links that greet each guest by name.
faq.tamilQ: Can the invitation be in Tamil?
faq.tamilA: Yes. Choose தமிழ் under Invitation language in the editor. Labels, dates and suggested stories switch to Tamil, and guests see it in Tamil.
faq.photosA: Clear, well-lit photos. You can crop each one before uploading and reorder them with the arrows — the first photo becomes the cover.
faq.paymentA: Payments go through Razorpay, a PCI-DSS compliant payment gateway. Card and UPI details are entered on Razorpay's secure form and never reach our servers.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: InviteForYou (inviteforyou.in) helps you create and share invitations. This policy explains, in plain language, what information we handle, why, who helps us handle it, and the choices you have. It is written with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 in mind.

collect.title: What we collect
body: Invitation content you enter: names, family names, dates, times, venues and their addresses, your story, FAQs, travel details, places nearby, and the photos and music you upload.
We do not ask you to create an account or a password. Each published invitation has a private edit link that only you receive.
Basic usage information: how many times an invitation was opened — a simple count, not who opened it.

phone.title: Your phone number
body: When you publish, we ask for your mobile number so we can send you your private edit link by WhatsApp or SMS. It is also used to tell you when an ended invitation is renewed.
Your number is stored privately with your invitation and is never shown on it. These messages are sent through Twilio.

guests.title: Information from your guests
body: When guests reply they may give their name, how many are coming, whether they can come, which side they are from, a message, and optionally a WhatsApp number for reminders.
Guest phone numbers are visible only to the invitation's owner, in the private guest list. They are never shown on the public invitation.
Messages from guests who accept may appear on the invitation's blessings wall. Photos guests upload appear in its shared guest gallery.

use.title: How we use information
body: To show your invitation to the people you share it with, record replies, let you manage your guest list, and send you your edit link.
To keep the service safe — for example, limiting repeated submissions from the same device. For this, IP addresses are kept briefly in memory and not stored.
We do not sell your information, and we do not use it for advertising or profiling.

maps.title: Maps & places nearby
body: If you search for your venue on the map, the words you type are sent from our server to OpenStreetMap to find it, and the venue's map position is sent to Wikipedia and Wikidata to suggest airports, stations and places nearby. Nothing about you is sent with them.

A venue you pin is saved with its map position so guests can get directions. Their Directions button opens Google Maps, which asks for their own location under Google's privacy policy — we never see it.

payments.title: Payments
body: Payments are processed by Razorpay. Your card, UPI or bank details are entered on Razorpay's secure checkout and never reach our servers.
We keep only the payment and order IDs needed to confirm your purchase, prevent misuse, and help with any issue or refund.

sharing.title: Who we share it with
body: Only the service providers that run InviteForYou, each for its own part: Google Firebase (database and file storage), Vercel (hosting), Razorpay (payments), Twilio (WhatsApp and SMS messages to you), and OpenStreetMap, Wikipedia and Wikidata (map search and nearby places, as above).
We may also disclose information when the law requires it. We never sell or rent it to anyone.

storage.title: Where data is stored & how it is protected
body: Invitations, replies and uploaded files are stored with Google Firebase; the website is hosted on Vercel. Some of these providers may store data outside India.
All traffic is encrypted (HTTPS). Only our servers can read the database; nobody can change your invitation or replace its photos without your edit link.
Published invitations and their photos can be seen by anyone who has the link — please share it only with the people you invite.

retention.title: How long we keep it
body: A published invitation stays live until 10 days after its event date. After that it is kept, read-only, so you can renew it — until you ask us to delete it.
Invitations saved but never paid for may be deleted. Payment records are kept for as long as Indian tax and accounting laws require.

device.title: Cookies & storage on your device
body: We use a few functional cookies and browser storage: your language, theme and motion preferences, an unsaved draft of the invitation you are creating (kept only on your device), and a note that you have already seen an invitation's opening so it does not replay on every visit.
We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.

support.title: When you contact us
body: If you write to us by email, your message reaches us through your email provider and its own privacy terms apply. We use what you send only to help you, and delete it when it is no longer needed.
Please never send us card numbers, OTPs or passwords — we will never ask for them.

yourData.title: Your rights & choices
body: You can change or remove invitation content at any time with your edit link.

You can ask us to see, correct or delete your information — including deleting a published invitation with its replies and photos — or withdraw consent, by contacting us with your invitation link. You may also nominate someone to act for you.
Guests who want their reply, message or phone number removed can ask the couple, or write to us directly.

children.title: Children
body: InviteForYou is meant to be used by adults. Invitations for a child's celebration (like a naming ceremony or birthday) are created by their parents or guardians, who decide what to include.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
body: If we change how we handle information, we will update this page and the date at the top. Important changes will also be shown on the site.

legal.grievance: Grievances are handled by the InviteForYou support team. We acknowledge every complaint within 24 hours and aim to resolve it within 15 days.

terms.title: Terms & conditions
terms.intro: These terms explain how InviteForYou (inviteforyou.in) works and what we each agree to when you create, publish or view an invitation. Please read them with our Privacy policy.

agreement.title: Agreeing to these terms
body: By using InviteForYou — creating, publishing, editing or replying to an invitation — you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.
You must be 18 or older, or have a parent or guardian's permission, to buy an invitation.

service.title: What we provide
body: An animated invitation website for your event, with a link to share, replies (RSVPs), a guest list, maps, a printable card and more, in English and Tamil.
We keep improving InviteForYou, so features and designs may change over time. We will not remove what you have paid for from a live invitation without good reason.

editLink.title: Your edit link
body: There are no accounts. After you pay, you receive a private edit link — it is the only key to edit your invitation and see your guest list. Keep it safe and do not share it.
Anyone with your edit link can change your invitation. If you lose it, contact us with your payment ID and the phone number you gave; we will help once we can confirm it is yours.

content.title: Your content
body: Everything you add — names, text, photos, music — stays yours. You give us permission to store it and show it to anyone who has your invitation's link, only to run the service.
You confirm you have the right to use what you upload, and the agreement of the people you name or show.

conduct.title: Acceptable use
body: Do not use InviteForYou for anything unlawful, hateful, obscene, misleading or harmful; to impersonate someone; to send spam; or to upload malware.
Do not try to break, overload, copy or scrape the service, or misuse your guests' information.

guests.title: Guests
body: Guests can reply, leave a blessing and add photos without signing up. The invitation's owner can see replies and guest phone numbers in the private guest list.
We may remove guest content that breaks these terms, and the owner can ask us to remove anything from their invitation.

pricing.title: Price & payment
body: Publishing an invitation costs the price shown for its design, paid once through Razorpay — no subscription. The price shown at checkout is the price you pay. Editing afterwards is free.
An invitation stays live until 10 days after its event date. You can renew an ended invitation for 30 more days for ₹50.

refunds.title: Refunds & cancellations
body: Your invitation is created and delivered the moment you pay, so payments are generally not refundable once it is published.

We give a full refund if you were charged twice, if you paid but your invitation was not published and we cannot fix it within 48 hours, or if a serious fault on our side we cannot fix stops your invitation from working. Ask within 7 days of paying, with your payment ID.
Approved refunds go back to your original payment method within 5–7 working days. There is nothing to cancel later — you can simply stop using the service.

availability.title: Availability
body: We work hard to keep InviteForYou running smoothly, but we cannot promise it will never be interrupted — for example during maintenance or an outage at one of our providers.
Please keep your own copies of anything important, like your photos.

thirdParties.title: Other services
body: Some features rely on other services with their own terms: Razorpay (payments), WhatsApp (sharing), Google Maps (directions), and OpenStreetMap, Wikipedia and Wikidata (map search and places nearby).
Travel and place suggestions are filled in automatically — please check them before sharing. Train timings are yours to add and confirm.

ip.title: Our designs
body: The templates, animations, illustrations, code and the InviteForYou name belong to us. You may use them for your own invitation, but not copy, resell or reuse them elsewhere.

liability.title: Limits of our responsibility
body: InviteForYou is provided as it is. As far as the law allows, we are not responsible for indirect losses — such as a guest missing a message — and our total responsibility for any invitation is limited to the amount you paid for it.
Nothing in these terms limits rights you have under Indian consumer law.

suspension.title: Removing content
body: We may hide or remove an invitation, or content in it, that breaks these terms or the law, or when legally required. Where we can, we will tell you first and explain why.

law.title: Law & disputes
body: These terms are governed by the laws of India. Please contact us first — most things can be sorted out quickly. Any dispute that remains will be decided by the courts of Tamil Nadu, India.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
body: We may update these terms. The date at the top shows the latest version; continuing to use the service after a change means you accept it.
